an3.97:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.97:1.3: idha bhikkhave, rañño bhadro assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti. balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.97:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.97:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an3.97:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.97:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.97:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an3.97:3.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo hoti akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahāṇāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an3.97:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an3.97:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an3.97:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an3.97:4.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
